data.long_meaning: Irtiqaatun is a name derived from the Arabic word 'irtiqaa' which means 'gift' or 'reward'. This name evokes a sense of appreciation and gratitude, as if the bearer is a cherished gift from Allah. The name Irtiqaatun carries the meaning “Gift, Reward” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Irtiqaatun usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, reward and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name serves as a constant reminder of the importance of being grateful and humble in the face of Allah's generosity.
